intuition: Each cuisine needs its best current food, with food name as the tie breaker.

brute_force.approach: Scan every food in a cuisine whenever its highest-rated item is requested.

optimal.approach: Keep current ratings in maps and use a heap per cuisine; discard heap entries whose rating is stale.
optimal.time: changeRating O(log n), highestRated O(log n) amortized

edge_cases: Equal ratings choose the lexicographically smaller food name.
Changing a rating updates only the food's cuisine heap.
